facts.fact: HAUS's Phase 2 terms of reference for the EU-funded open data hackathons programme in Botswana refer to the anticipated adoption of the national Open Data Policy by Parliament, so the policy is written and not yet adopted; the document states no approval or launch.

systems.owner: EU Support to Digital Transformation in Botswana project (Expertise France, ESTDEV, HAUS) with BDIH and SmartBots

note: No portal fact: the document names no national open data portal; SmartBots Lab exposes curated open datasets to innovators through sandbox interfaces and is not stated to be a government portal tied to the policy.
